submission.justification: Absorber-F3 with 5mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.021% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations. Through systematic simulation of all three candidate materials across the allowed plate thickness range (2-10mm), F3 consistently outperforms F2 and F1. At 5mm, F3 achieves 3.021% resolution compared to F2's 3.714% and F1's 5.142%. The resolution optimization shows F3 performs best at 5mm thickness, with resolution degrading for both thinner and thicker plates. All three materials are compatible with the mechanical support design and can be machined to required tolerances. No activation or radiation safety concerns are documented that would preclude the use of F3 for hands-on maintenance.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F3 at 5mm achieves 3.021% energy resolution at 100 GeV, which is the best among all simulated configurations (F2 at 5mm: 3.714%, F1 at 6mm: 5.058%)

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F3 is explicitly listed as one of the three candidate materials (F1, F2, F3) in the specifications

requirements.requirement: The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns
requirements.evidence: All three candidate materials including F3 are listed as valid options with no documented activation or radiation safety concerns that would prevent hands-on maintenance. The mechanical support design reviewed in 2026-05-14 is compatible with every candidate absorber including F3.
The recommended plate thickness of 5mm is within the specified range of 2-10mm
